slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a calm, elegant paperwork moment that says 'this is straightforward' to a luxury destination-wedding reader, bridging home and abroad.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2 with clear space on one side for the title. Overhead or 45 degree still life on cream linen or pale stone: a pair of wedding rings, a fine fountain pen, a plain ivory document folder tied with silk ribbon, two closed passports (covers only, country-neutral), a sprig of olive or white florals. Soft natural window light, warm neutral palette, no people, no hands. No real, readable government form or certificate: no legible registry text, crest, coat of arms, names, dates, registration numbers, signatures, barcodes or photos. Any paperwork must be blank, softly out of focus or turned so nothing is legible. No passport data page. Source order: library register, Canva brand asset, or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to library-index.csv. Never a competitor, directory, celebrant-blog, registry or search-result image. An AI still life is allowed under sources-policy.md (flat-lay, no real place, person or wedding) only if the user approves, labelled 'Illustrative image' in the caption.

Real people only: licensed real wedding with written couple and celebrant consent (guest consent if identifiable). Source: library register, own-site image with licence verified, or a photographer's licensed image added to the register. Never AI, never stock presented as a real wedding, never a competitor or celebrant-blog image.
